entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A young pyromancer and planeswalker with a temper and limited self-control, whose origin story the novel tells.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who tracks Chandra across planes and turns her in, then helps her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A blue mage with whom Chandra has a brief run-in.

entities.name: Jurl
entities.description: A goblin who was Chandra's last remaining ally, later guide to Gideon and Chandra on Diraden.

entities.name: Falia
entities.description: The menarch of a Diraden village who looks like a child but has an adult's wisdom through Blood Magic.

entities.name: Prince Velrav
entities.description: The ageless necromancer immortal prince of Diraden, son of King Gelidor, who hopes to become a planeswalker.

entities.name: King Gelidor
entities.description: Velrav's father, who allies with Chandra and Gideon and impales himself on Chandra's sword of fire.

entities.name: Samir Mia Kauldi
entities.description: Chandra's woodland friend on Regatha, who has already met Gideon at the headquarters of the Order.

entities.name: Walbert III
entities.description: The leader of the Order of Heliud, who plans to offer Chandra to the Purifying Fire.

entities.name: Fog Riders
entities.description: Servants summoned by Falia to abduct Chandra.

entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: A sect of mages bent on imposing draconian law across the land.

entities.name: The Prelate's officers
entities.description: Officers to whom Gideon turns Chandra in.

entities.name: Dragon Scroll
entities.description: A scroll Chandra steals back from Kephalai, originating on Zendikar.

entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: A ritual fire that searches a person's soul and purifies fire magic.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: The plane where Chandra goes to steal back the Dragon Scroll.

entities.name: Aretopolis
entities.description: The city on Kephalai whose Sanctum of Stars Chandra destroys.

entities.name: Diraden
entities.description: A plane dominated by black mana and endless night, ruled by an immortal prince.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Keral Keep
entities.description: Chandra's home keep, which the Order besieges.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The origin of the Dragon Scroll, to which Chandra leaves at the end.

events.summary: Chandra has a brief run-in with a blue mage, Jace Beleren.
events.quote: Chandra has a brief run-in with a blue mage

events.summary: Chandra steals the Dragon Scroll in Kephalai and destroys Aretopolis's Sanctum of Stars by accidental overuse of power.
events.quote: she destroys Aretopolis 's Sanctum of Stars by accidental overuse of power

events.summary: Gideon tracks Chandra down, incapacitates her and turns her in to the Prelate's officers.
events.quote: he incapacitates Chandra and turns her in to the Prelate's officers

events.summary: Gideon follows Chandra to Diraden, where the prince's shroud of night prevents planeswalking, and Jurl attacks but is subdued.
Falia, smitten with Gideon, sends him hunting and summons Fog Riders to abduct Chandra; Gideon kills one Fog Rider before both are captured.
events.quote: slays one of the Fog Riders before both he and Chandra are incapacitated and abducted

events.summary: Chandra tells Velrav of planeswalkers to win Gideon better treatment, and Velrav decides to harness Gideon's essence.
events.quote: Velrav now believes he can harness Gideon's essence to become a planeswalker himself

events.summary: Chandra beheads Prince Velrav with a sword of fire and King Gelidor impales himself on it, lifting the spell preventing planeswalking.
events.quote: Chandra creates a sword of fire and beheads the prince.

events.summary: Samir reveals he has already met Gideon at the Order's headquarters, and Chandra feels betrayed and leaves Gideon.
events.quote: Feeling betrayed by Gideon's lies, she leaves him to fend for himself

events.summary: The Order besieges Keral Keep and Chandra surrenders; Gideon escorts her to Walbert III, who plans to offer her to the Purifying Fire.
events.quote: When Chandra surrenders, Gideon is sent to escort her to the Order of Heliud's leader Walbert III .

events.summary: Chandra confesses to Gideon her accidental part in the death of her village and parents.
events.quote: Chandra confesses to Gideon the accidental part she played in the death of her village and her parents

events.summary: Chandra walks into the Purifying Fire, finds it has nothing to purify, and emerges unharmed and stronger.
events.quote: it finds nothing to purify and leaves Chandra not only unharmed but greatly bolstered in strength

events.summary: Chandra destroys Walbert and his guards and collapses the temple.
events.quote: Chandra destroyed Walbert and his guards

events.summary: Gideon promises to cover for her if she leaves, Chandra warns him of the Order's ideals, and she leaves for Zendikar.
events.quote: Chandra held her promise and left then for the plane of Zendikar

relations.note: the Order's influence offends all she holds sacred
relations.quote: The Order's ever-increasing influence is an affront to all Chandra holds sacred
the Order of Heliud's leader Walbert III

relations.note: beheaded him with a sword of fire
relations.quote: Chandra creates a sword of fire and beheads the prince.

relations.note: destroyed him after the Purifying Fire
relations.quote: Chandra destroyed Walbert and his guards

relations.note: he swears to cover for her
relations.quote: swears he will cover for her
Chandra's woodland friend Samir Mia Kauldi
